title: Profile lookup failures
summary: profile-api could not resolve the identity service after a DNS rollout

logs: coredns INFO serving other zones normally
deployments: service record identity.svc renamed to identity-api.svc at 11:03Z

runbooks.title: Service DNS failure
runbooks.content: For a concentrated NXDOMAIN spike, compare service records and client names. Restore the compatible record and verify resolver caches.

oracle.root_cause: A DNS rollout removed the identity.svc record still used by profile-api.
